description: Source-backed contract for FOnline particle authoring, baking, runtime backends, Mapper tooling, integrations, and validation.

scope.support_note: SPARK and Effekseer are independent optional backends. Embedding projects must pin an Engine revision and explicitly enable, test, and support the formats they ship.
included: backend-neutral particle runtime and sprite integration
Mapper preview and SPARK authoring tools
excluded: embedding-project particle catalogs, filenames, visual policy, and budgets
project-selected effects, textures, models, and acceptance scenes
unsupported Effekseer renderer families and advanced capabilities
upstream editor behavior that is not present in the bundled tools
generated .spk and .efk files as authored source

object_families.name: SPARK backend
object_families.requirement: Enable FO_SPARK_PARTICLES to compile the SPARK baker, runtime backend, and Mapper authoring subeditor.
object_families.rationale: Backend selection is explicit and independent of Effekseer.

anchors: "description": "Compile the SPARK particle baker, runtime backend, and Mapper authoring tools."

object_families.name: Effekseer backend
object_families.requirement: Enable FO_EFFEKSEER_PARTICLES to compile the fixed-profile project compiler and Effekseer runtime backend.
object_families.rationale: Backend selection is explicit and independent of SPARK.

anchors: "description": "Compile the Effekseer project compiler and runtime backend."

object_families.name: Core
object_families.requirement: Author exactly one System root object and compose one or more Group objects beneath its groups attribute.
object_families.rationale: The SPARK loader accepts one and only one System and the runtime/render paths consume its groups.

object_families.name: Interpolators
object_families.requirement: Use only the registered float and color initializer/interpolator tags for particle parameter evolution.
object_families.rationale: The XML loader constructs object tags through the IOManager registry.

object_families.name: Zones
object_families.requirement: Emitter and zoned-modifier references may use the six registered geometric zone tags.
object_families.rationale: Other SPARK zone implementations are not available to authored Engine resources unless registered and editor-supported.

object_families.name: Emitters
object_families.requirement: Groups may contain the five registered emitter tags.
object_families.rationale: Registration and editor creation controls define the portable authored emitter set.

object_families.name: Modifiers
object_families.requirement: Groups may contain the eleven registered modifier tags.
object_families.rationale: The list is the complete modifier surface recognized by both the loader and stock editor.

object_families.name: Actions
object_families.requirement: Birth/death action references may use ActionSet and SpawnParticlesAction.
object_families.rationale: These are the only action object tags registered by the vendored SPARK build.

object_families.name: Renderer
object_families.requirement: Use the Engine-owned SparkQuadRenderer tag for particle rendering.
object_families.rationale: The Engine registers this custom renderer once before loading particle resources and exposes no other SPARK renderer to the editor.

objects.name: SPARK source
objects.requirement: Author SPARK systems as XML in .spark files and reference the corresponding .spk path from game content.
objects.rationale: ParticleBaker parses XML and emits the runtime binary; runtime never loads the source file.

objects.name: SPARK runtime binary
objects.requirement: Treat .spk as generated baked output and never check it into an authored resource source.
objects.rationale: ParticleBaker rejects authored .spk files and the runtime backend advertises only spk.

anchors: Authored SPARK particles must use the text .spark format

objects.name: Effekseer project source
objects.requirement: Author Effekseer effects as text .efkproj projects and reference the corresponding .efk path from game content.
objects.rationale: The fixed-profile compiler converts project XML into the runtime binary during baking.

objects.name: Effekseer runtime binary
objects.requirement: Treat .efk as generated baked output and never check it into an authored resource source.
objects.rationale: ParticleBaker rejects authored .efk files, validates SKFE output, and the runtime backend advertises only efk.

anchors: Authored Effekseer particles must use the text .efkproj format

xml_rules.name: SPARK XML graph
xml_rules.requirement: A .spark source must be accepted by the vendored SPARK XML loader and contain a usable System graph.
xml_rules.rationale: Baking fails when loadFromBuffer("xml", ...) returns no system.

anchors: Failed to load SPARK particle XML

xml_rules.name: SPARK texture paths
xml_rules.requirement: SPARK texture paths must be relative, contain no line-control characters, and remain inside the particle's resource source.
xml_rules.rationale: The baker rejects absolute and escaping paths before producing .spk.

anchors: SPARK particle texture path must be relative
SPARK particle texture path escapes its resource source

xml_rules.name: Effekseer project XML
xml_rules.requirement: An .efkproj source must be a non-empty EffekseerProject XML document supported by the fixed compiler profile.
xml_rules.rationale: The native compiler rejects malformed XML and unsupported profile features during baking.

anchors: Effekseer source is not an EffekseerProject XML document

xml_rules.name: Effekseer dependency paths
xml_rules.requirement: Keep compiler-reported dependencies relative and inside the directory resource source that owns the project.
xml_rules.rationale: Dependency snapshots and compilation resolve against the physical project directory and reject escapes.

anchors: Effekseer project dependency path must be relative
Effekseer project dependency escapes its directory resource source

xml_rules.name: SPARK document root
xml_rules.requirement: The document element must be named SPARK exactly.
xml_rules.rationale: The XML loader rejects missing or differently named roots before graph construction.

xml_rules.name: Exactly one System
xml_rules.requirement: The graph must contain exactly one System object; nested helper objects do not replace it and a second System is invalid.
xml_rules.rationale: Graph validation selects the sole System as the load result.

anchors: One and only one system is allowed in the graph

xml_rules.name: Registered object tags
xml_rules.requirement: Every object element name must match one of the registered object tags in the generated catalog.
xml_rules.rationale: Graph::addNode fails when IOManager cannot construct the named object.

xml_rules.name: Attribute elements
xml_rules.requirement: Serialize descriptor values as attrib children with a non-empty id matching the object's descriptor attribute name.
xml_rules.rationale: The loader ignores non-attrib children at attribute level and looks up each id in the descriptor.

xml_rules.name: Value attribute or text
xml_rules.requirement: A scalar or array value may be written in the attrib value XML attribute or as element text; value takes precedence when both exist.
xml_rules.rationale: XMLLoader::getValue checks the value attribute first and otherwise reads child text.

xml_rules.name: Semicolon arrays
xml_rules.requirement: Separate array values with semicolons; each element is converted independently and at least one converted value is required before assignment.
xml_rules.rationale: convert2Array splits only on semicolons and returns false for an empty conversion result.

xml_rules.name: Nested objects and references
xml_rules.requirement: Reference attributes may nest an object directly or identify a previously described shared object through ref; arrays of references use nested objects and Ref children.
xml_rules.rationale: The loader resolves both inline graph nodes and integer reference IDs, while the saver emits references according to graph sharing.

xml_rules.name: Names and unknown attributes
xml_rules.requirement: Write an object's optional display name in its name XML attribute. Unknown non-empty attrib ids are logged as warnings and skipped rather than becoming custom data.
xml_rules.rationale: Names have a dedicated descriptor path, and typoed attributes do not affect the loaded object.

renderer_fields.name: SPARK draw route
renderer_fields.requirement: Use atlas rendering for ordinary particle sprites; enable DrawInScene when the effect must share the map scene and depth path.
renderer_fields.rationale: The SPARK runtime promotes the complete particle system to direct-scene rendering when a renderer requests it.

renderer_fields.name: SPARK effect and texture
renderer_fields.requirement: Select a baked FOnline effect and a texture path valid for the particle resource source.
renderer_fields.rationale: SparkQuadRenderer imports both values and uses FOnline rendering resources.

renderer_fields.name: Effekseer direct-scene route
renderer_fields.requirement: Treat Effekseer effects as direct-scene particles and validate their supported renderer capabilities in the FOnline client.
renderer_fields.rationale: The Effekseer runtime supplies callback geometry to FOnline rather than using the atlas route.

renderer_fields.name: Effekseer callback geometry
renderer_fields.requirement: Use only Root, None, Sprite, Ring, Ribbon, Track, and Model nodes; the five drawing families are converted to Engine-owned callback geometry.
renderer_fields.rationale: The FOnline runtime does not use Effekseer's graphics backend and fails closed on unimplemented node families.

anchors: only Root, None, Sprite, Ring, Ribbon, Track, and Model nodes are supported

renderer_fields.name: Effekseer material and sampling profile
renderer_fields.requirement: Use the Default material, Normal/Add/Sub blending, nearest or linear filtering, and Clamp or Repeat wrapping. Multiply blending, mirrored wrapping, advanced texture slots, custom materials, soft particles, falloff, and flipbook interpolation are rejected.
renderer_fields.rationale: The callback renderers implement a deliberately bounded material profile and validate it before drawing.

anchors: advanced material, soft-particle, or flipbook features are unsupported

renderer_fields.name: Effekseer depth, culling, and sorting
renderer_fields.requirement: Sprite and Ring may use stable camera-depth sorting; Ribbon, Track, and Model reject Z-sort. Per-node ZTest/ZWrite select an effect depth variant, and Model face culling selects the Engine draw cull mode.
renderer_fields.rationale: Draw state and ordering are preserved only where the callback geometry can implement them without breaking strip or model topology.

renderer_fields.name: Effekseer sprite distortion
renderer_fields.requirement: Use scene distortion only on Sprite nodes with a distortion texture and finite intensity; the draw samples a deferred scene-background snapshot through BackgroundTex and ParticleSamplingBuf.
renderer_fields.rationale: Only sprite geometry supplies the refracting plane required by the Engine distortion effect.

anchors: only Sprite nodes can refract the scene

renderer_fields.name: Effekseer global exclusions
renderer_fields.requirement: Do not use GPU particles, normal textures, sounds, custom materials, external curves, or procedural models. Referenced static model resources must load and pass FOnline validation.
renderer_fields.rationale: The runtime rejects unsupported global resources before accepting the effect.

anchors: normal textures, sounds, custom materials, and external curves are unsupported
model resource failed validation or loading

renderer_fields.name: Direct scene rendering
renderer_fields.requirement: When any group renderer enables draw in scene, the whole ParticleSprite uses the direct map-scene path instead of atlas refresh.
renderer_fields.rationale: A ParticleSprite has one render route, selected after scanning all groups.

renderer_fields.name: Quad effect
renderer_fields.requirement: Name a baked .fofx resource compatible with EffectUsage::QuadSprite; the renderer loads it through EffectManager.
renderer_fields.rationale: Blend, depth, and shader behavior come from the selected Engine effect.

renderer_fields.name: Inert blend mode declaration
renderer_fields.requirement: Do not author blend mode: the descriptor declares it, but SparkQuadRenderer neither imports, exports, nor applies it. Select blending in the .fofx effect instead.
renderer_fields.rationale: Treating this field as active would create resources whose appearance depends on a control the runtime ignores.

renderer_fields.name: Particle texture
renderer_fields.requirement: Resolve a supported sprite resource relative to the .spark source directory and load its atlas texture through the provided texture loader.
renderer_fields.rationale: Relative texture names keep particle packs relocatable while reusing the Engine image pipeline.

renderer_fields.name: Quad scale
renderer_fields.requirement: One value changes X while retaining default Y; two values set X and Y particle-quad scale.
renderer_fields.rationale: The Engine maps the field directly to SPARK QuadRenderBehavior scale.

renderer_fields.name: Texture atlas dimensions
renderer_fields.requirement: One value sets the X cell count; two set X and Y. The particle texture-index parameter chooses atlas cells.
renderer_fields.rationale: Atlas dimensions control UV subdivision rather than the Engine TextureAtlas allocator.

renderer_fields.name: Look orientation
renderer_fields.requirement: Use one of the four recognized look-orientation names; other strings leave the default orientation unchanged.
renderer_fields.rationale: String parsing is an explicit closed branch in SparkQuadRenderer import.

renderer_fields.name: Up orientation
renderer_fields.requirement: Use one of the four recognized up-orientation names; other strings leave the default orientation unchanged.
renderer_fields.rationale: The renderer maps these exact names to SPARK oriented-quad modes.

renderer_fields.name: Locked axis
renderer_fields.requirement: Use LOCK_LOOK or LOCK_UP when an axis-based orientation mode needs one vector held fixed.
renderer_fields.rationale: Only these two names are imported and exported.

renderer_fields.name: Locked look vector
renderer_fields.requirement: Provide the world/local look vector used by the selected oriented-quad mode.
renderer_fields.rationale: The value is imported directly into SPARK's lookVector.

renderer_fields.name: Locked up vector
renderer_fields.requirement: Provide the world/local up vector used by the selected oriented-quad mode.
renderer_fields.rationale: The value is imported directly into SPARK's upVector.

tooling_rules.name: Backend-neutral Mapper preview
tooling_rules.requirement: Preview baked .spk and .efk resources through the Mapper particle window using explicit placement, seed, scale, offset, and optional prewarm.
tooling_rules.rationale: The preview uses the same ParticleSystem facade and runtime extensions as the game.

tooling_rules.name: Mapper SPARK editor
tooling_rules.requirement: Edit raw .spark assets in Mapper, save through the SPARK XML saver, then rebake and recreate the .spk preview.
tooling_rules.rationale: The editor reads source assets while previewing the baked runtime form.

tooling_rules.name: Standalone Effekseer Editor
tooling_rules.requirement: Build and stage the Windows Effekseer authoring tool through buildtools.py build-auxiliary; do not ship it as a game runtime dependency.
tooling_rules.rationale: The editor has an isolated auxiliary build and staged payload.

anchors: The Effekseer Editor auxiliary build requires Windows

tooling_rules.name: Effekseer dependency cache
tooling_rules.requirement: Let ParticleBaker track compiler-reported dependency snapshots; force a full rebake after changing compiler behavior.
tooling_rules.rationale: The cache invalidates an effect when its project or dependencies change.

anchors: Failed to write Effekseer dependency cache

tooling_rules.name: Serializer-normalized round trip
tooling_rules.requirement: Expect Save to rewrite object ordering, optional/default fields, nesting, references, and formatting according to the SPARK graph serializer; review the semantic diff.
tooling_rules.rationale: The editor saves an object graph, not a token-preserving XML syntax tree.

runtime_rules.name: Backend composition
runtime_rules.requirement: Compile only the particle backends selected by FO_SPARK_PARTICLES and FO_EFFEKSEER_PARTICLES.
runtime_rules.rationale: CreateParticleRuntimeBackends is the single feature-aware composition point.

runtime_rules.name: Runtime extension routing
runtime_rules.requirement: Reference baked .spk or .efk paths; ParticleManager selects a backend by its advertised extension.
runtime_rules.rationale: Authored source extensions are not runtime sprite formats.

runtime_rules.name: Seeded respawn
runtime_rules.requirement: Use an explicit seed when deterministic replay or comparison is required.
runtime_rules.rationale: The neutral facade forwards the seed to the selected backend.

runtime_rules.name: Runtime scale
runtime_rules.requirement: Apply finite positive scale through ParticleSystem and revalidate bounds, depth, and attachment placement.
runtime_rules.rationale: Scale is part of the backend-neutral runtime setup and forces a transform refresh.

runtime_rules.name: Mandatory baked bounds
runtime_rules.requirement: Bake each particle system's simulated position box and maximum billboard radius into the runtime resource. SPARK rejects a system that never shows a particle; Effekseer appends and validates a mandatory bounds trailer.
runtime_rules.rationale: Static measured bounds replace manual draw dimensions and avoid recomputing a particle AABB every frame.

anchors: deterministic run of a throwaway copy
SPARK particle system showed no visible particles while baking its bounds
Baked Effekseer binary is missing its mandatory bounds trailer magic

runtime_rules.name: Position box and billboard radius
runtime_rules.requirement: Treat ParticleBounds3D.PositionMin/PositionMax as world positions transformed by the full placement matrix, and BillboardRadius as camera-facing padding transformed by placement scale only.
runtime_rules.rationale: Rotating or sweeping billboard radius as a world point overstates the frame and can still misrepresent its screen footprint.

runtime_rules.name: Live bounds
runtime_rules.requirement: GetLiveBounds returns transformed baked bounds only while the backend has live particles or instances; dormant and finished systems reserve no model-frame space.
runtime_rules.rationale: Occasional attached effects must expand their owning model only while visible.

runtime_rules.name: Automatic particle sprite frame
runtime_rules.requirement: ParticleSystem projects baked bounds through the map-camera tilt, adds billboard and antialiasing margins, and derives atlas size, emitter offset, and world transform automatically. Invalid or unavailable bounds fall back to Render.DefaultParticleDrawWidth/Height.
runtime_rules.rationale: ParticleSprite allocation follows measured effect content without an authored draw-size field.

runtime_rules.name: Prewarm
runtime_rules.requirement: Use prewarm only when the effect must enter already simulated, and include its cost in the project performance gate.
runtime_rules.rationale: The runtime advances the selected backend and resets facade timing to the reported elapsed time.

runtime_rules.name: Update cadence
runtime_rules.requirement: Render.Animation3dFPS sets the millisecond particle update threshold; zero leaves the threshold at zero and therefore permits an update every frame.
runtime_rules.rationale: Particle simulation cadence shares the 3D animation setting rather than owning an independent particle FPS.

runtime_rules.name: Default offscreen-atlas path
runtime_rules.requirement: With draw in scene false, updates render the SPARK system into an intermediate render target and copy it into the sprite atlas; normal sprite batching draws the resulting quad.
runtime_rules.rationale: The default path preserves ordinary sprite ordering and batching at the cost of flattening particle depth.

runtime_rules.name: Direct map-scene path
runtime_rules.requirement: With draw in scene true, ParticleSprite is direct-draw and renders SPARK geometry against the map projection and shared depth target instead of refreshing its atlas region.
runtime_rules.rationale: World-space particles can be occluded by standing sprites and models according to the selected .fofx depth state.

runtime_rules.name: ParticleSprite animation semantics
runtime_rules.requirement: ParticleSprite is non-copyable and never hit-tests; Play respawns, Stop is a no-op, SetTime and SetDir are ignored, and IsPlaying mirrors SPARK active state.
runtime_rules.rationale: Generic Sprite animation controls do not map to SPARK timeline or direction selection.

runtime_rules.name: Shared model and particle scale
runtime_rules.requirement: Render.ModelProjFactor is screen pixels per 3D world unit for models and in-scene particles. The Engine default is 40.0; embedding projects may override it consistently.
runtime_rules.rationale: ParticleSprite and model projection use the same scale setting, so project overrides affect both.

integration_rules.name: Sprite integration
integration_rules.requirement: Load particle sprites through ParticleSpriteFactory and let the backend choose atlas or direct-scene rendering.
integration_rules.rationale: The factory exposes enabled runtime extensions and constructs ParticleSprite from ParticleManager.

integration_rules.name: Model attachment
integration_rules.requirement: Use AttachParticles with a baked runtime resource and a valid model bone, then verify transforms and lifetime in a visible scene.
integration_rules.rationale: The model baker verifies the resource and runtime creates the particle at the target joint.

anchors: Particle model link target bone not found

integration_rules.name: Client script controls
integration_rules.requirement: Use the client API for seeded playback, prewarm, scale, or live critter-bone effects and handle a false result where the API reports one.
integration_rules.rationale: The exported methods narrow generic sprites to particle sprites before applying backend-neutral controls.

integration_rules.name: Embedding-project ownership
integration_rules.requirement: Keep particle catalogs, visual policy, backend selection, resource provenance, performance budgets, and acceptance scenes in project documentation.
integration_rules.rationale: The Engine documents reusable mechanics but cannot define a game's assets or production targets.

integration_rules.name: Critter model particle
integration_rules.requirement: Critter.RunParticle creates a named particle on a model bone only in FO_ENABLE_3D builds; the export is a no-op otherwise.
integration_rules.rationale: The script method depends on an active ModelInstance and is not a 2D critter-sprite fallback.

integration_rules.name: .fo3d AttachParticles
integration_rules.requirement: A layer/value-selected .fo3d link stores a global baked .spk or .efk path and requires a valid target bone; it lives only while the selected link remains active.
integration_rules.rationale: ModelInfoBaker validates the resource and bone, and runtime creates/removes the particle with model composition.

anchors: Particle model link has no target bone

validation_rules.name: Documentation contract
validation_rules.requirement: Run docs_particle_format.py --check and its focused unit test after changing particle formats, backends, tools, or integrations.
validation_rules.rationale: The manifest validates every source anchor and generated page.

validation_rules.name: Particle baker tests
validation_rules.requirement: Run the ParticleBaker unit tests after changing source formats, transforms, path checks, compiler output, or dependency invalidation.
validation_rules.rationale: The native suite exercises both backend bake boundaries.

validation_rules.name: Effekseer runtime tests
validation_rules.requirement: Run the focused Effekseer runtime tests after changing compiler/runtime geometry, sorting, batching, textures, seed, or scale.
validation_rules.rationale: The suite checks deterministic callback geometry and supported runtime behavior.

anchors: Effekseer particle runtime produces deterministic FOnline callback geometry

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project bake
validation_rules.requirement: Rebake an affected embedding project and reject authored .spk/.efk, malformed sources, missing dependencies, and stale generated resources.
validation_rules.rationale: Only the project bake sees its complete resource graph and feature selection.

validation_rules.name: Visible runtime validation
validation_rules.requirement: Inspect every affected backend and integration route in Mapper and a representative client scene, including depth, clipping, lifetime, transforms, and performance.
validation_rules.rationale: Successful compilation cannot prove visual correctness or gameplay timing.

validation_rules.name: Both render routes
validation_rules.requirement: Visibly check atlas particles and direct-scene particles at their real draw order, camera angle, scale, depth occluders, and supported renderer backends.
validation_rules.rationale: Headless parsing cannot prove framing, alpha, blend, depth, orientation, or world-scale behavior.
